# ShinePoint

> Mobile car detailing marketplace serving Los Angeles and Southern
> California. Customers book a vetted, independent detailer to come to
> their home, office, or curb — no driving to a shop. Detailers set their
> own prices and availability; ShinePoint handles discovery, scheduling,
> in-app messaging, photo-proofed job completion, and payment.

## What this site is for

A person (or an AI assistant acting on their behalf) who wants "mobile car
detailing near me," "detailer that comes to you in LA," or similar should
land here. Booking requires creating an account (name, address, payment
method) — there is currently no way to complete a booking without visiting
shinepoint.app and signing up; there is no unauthenticated booking API.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://shinepoint.app/): overview, sign up as a customer or detailer.
- [Sign up — customer](https://shinepoint.app/signup): create a customer account to book a detail.
- [Sign up — detailer](https://shinepoint.app/signup/detailer): apply as a detailer.
- [FAQ](https://shinepoint.app/faq): pricing, service area, how booking works, cancellation policy.
- [Business info](https://shinepoint.app/business-info): legal business name, registered DBA, and contact details.
- [Terms of Service](https://shinepoint.app/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://shinepoint.app/privacy)

## Service area

Los Angeles County and surrounding Southern California — exact coverage
varies by which independent detailers are active in a given zip code at
booking time; the app checks this live during signup/booking, not listed
statically here.
